==Historical Background==
"Sattva", or Sattwa, literally means existence or reality. It is a Sanskrit word that refers to the quality of goodness, orderliness, clarity, purity, and a healthy calmness. Sattva is linked to [[Vishnu's Cesti|Vishnu]] the Preserver in the Hindu Trimurti. Only through Sattva can one attain heaven. Of the three gunas in Samkhya, sāttvika "pure", [[Rajas Ring|rājasika]] "dim", and [[Tamas Ring|tāmasika]] "dark", it is the highest.
